whatIsVocaliz: Vocaliz dandamali ne don ƙirƙirar Salons. A Salon an ƙunshi har ɗakunan sauti guda 3, kowane ɗaki tare da ɗan adam da wakilin muryar AI. Sadarwa tsakanin ɗakunan tana ta hanyar taken kai tsaye wanda kowane ɗan adam zai iya tambayar wakilin muryarsu ya raba a cikin Salon.
